attchmntText: Compucom Software Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Compucom Software Limited approved the Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results at a meeting held on 13th November 2026. The financial results were published in the Financial Express and Nafa Nuksan newspapers on 14th November 2026. The documents are available on the company website at www.compucom.co.in. The company also submitted a copy of the newspaper publication to BSE Limited and National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 47(1) of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015.

attchmntText: Compucom Software Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Compucom Software Limited approved its Un-Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The Board took on record the Limited Review Report. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 1,412.55 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 202.07 lakhs. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 1,684.05 lakhs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 241.15 lakhs. The trading window for designated persons will open after 48 hours of the declaration.
